item.text: I’ll continue with another small shared type. `Gender` currently uses `Math.random()` independently of the project’s `Randomizer`, so I’ll bring it into the same deterministic randomization path and simplify the selection logic.
`Gender.getRandom()` can be reduced to a direct choice between `MALE` and `FEMALE`, avoiding the retry loop and making it respect the project-wide seed. I’ll make that change now.
The enum now uses the shared randomizer and no longer needs a retry loop. I’ll compile and run the final checks.
